model_pricing_audio_complete.name: model_pricing_audio_complete
model_pricing_audio_complete.value: ("model_pricing"."audio_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."audio_output_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."cached_audio_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL) OR ("model_pricing"."audio_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "model_pricing"."audio_output_per_mtok_usd" IS NOT NULL)

model_pricing_long_context_complete.name: model_pricing_long_context_complete
model_pricing_long_context_complete.value: ("model_pricing"."long_context_threshold_tokens" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_output_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_cached_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_cache_write_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_cache_write_1h_per_mtok_usd" IS NULL) OR ("model_pricing"."long_context_threshold_tokens" > 0 AND "model_pricing"."long_input_per_mtok_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "model_pricing"."long_output_per_mtok_usd" IS NOT NULL)

usage_events_pricing_status_valid.name: usage_events_pricing_status_valid
usage_events_pricing_status_valid.value: ("usage_events"."pricing_status" = 'priced' and "usage_events"."cost_usd" is not null and "usage_events"."unpriced_reason" is null) or ("usage_events"."pricing_status" = 'unpriced' and "usage_events"."cost_usd" is null and "usage_events"."unpriced_reason" in ('no_pricing', 'no_tier_pricing', 'no_batch_pricing', 'no_audio_pricing', 'no_web_search_pricing'))

usage_events_audio_valid.name: usage_events_audio_valid
usage_events_audio_valid.value: "usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."audio_input_tokens" AND "usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."cached_input_tokens" AND ("usage_events"."audio_input_tokens" = 0 OR "usage_events"."audio_input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cached_input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cache_write_input_tokens") AND "usage_events"."audio_output_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_events"."audio_output_tokens" <= "usage_events"."output_tokens"

usage_events_image_valid.name: usage_events_image_valid
usage_events_image_valid.value: "usage_events"."cached_image_input_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_events"."cached_image_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."image_input_tokens" AND "usage_events"."image_output_tokens" >= 0 AND ("usage_events"."image_input_tokens" = 0 AND "usage_events"."image_output_tokens" = 0 OR ("usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" + "usage_events"."cached_image_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."cached_input_tokens" AND "usage_events"."audio_input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cached_audio_input_tokens" + "usage_events"."image_input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cached_image_input_tokens" <= "usage_events"."input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cached_input_tokens" - "usage_events"."cache_write_input_tokens" AND "usage_events"."audio_output_tokens" + "usage_events"."image_output_tokens" <= "usage_events"."output_tokens"))
